threshold_note: Applied only inside the fixed cohort-1 candidate set. Thresholds never admit a molecule, never remove one, and say nothing about physiological exposure. Curated weak relationships (e.g. caffeine's curated ADORA3 mechanism at Ki = 100 uM) keep their catalogue membership and their curated tier at every threshold.
